name: fortinet-mr-pre-review
description: Single-shot Fortinet GitLab MR pre-review. User provides an MR URL; pipeline fetches MR meta + diff + discussion, runs Claude analysis per user_prompt focus, posts a '🤖 Forge pre-review:' comment, and opens a Forge chat session for the human reviewer to drill into. Copy of mr-pre-review simplified for manual single runs.
author: forge
